Q10283_RequestOfIceMerchant/32760-06.htm.text: Jinia: Go back to Freya first. I'll see you there.

Q10283_RequestOfIceMerchant/32760-01.htm.text: Jinia: Who are you? What are you doing to Kier? Stay away from him, he's done nothing to deserve this disrespect.

links.text: "I apologize. You have nothing to fear."

Q10283_RequestOfIceMerchant/32760-05.htm.text: Jinia: Poor Kier... you were warned about the Ice Queen! But you wouldn't listen...

Q10284_AcquisitionOfDivineSword/32760-01.text: Jinia: Before I tell you about this mission, there's a lot we need to discuss. Our guild has a long history and it's important you understand what we're trying to accomplish.
when: state STARTED; memo 1; memoStateEx1 == 0; memoStateEx2 == 0; memoStateEx3 == 0

Q10284_AcquisitionOfDivineSword/32760-01.text: Jinia: What else would you like to know?

Q10284_AcquisitionOfDivineSword/32760-01.text: Jinia: Now what can I tell you about?
Jinia: What do you want to hear next?
Jinia: All I have left to tell you is about the Ice Queen. After that, I will ask something very important of you.
Jinia: All I have left to tell you is about the Jinia Guild. After that, I will ask something very important of you.
Jinia: All I have left to tell you is about the Divine Sword. After that, I will ask something very important of you.
Jinia: You've heard the stories. Can I now discuss your mission?

Q10285_MeetingSirra/32760-01.html.text: Jinia: Quite commendable! Kegor told me of your exploits. The Guild has much to thank you for. It is without saying that Jinia Guild is forever indebted to you. I... there is more to tell, however.

Q10285_MeetingSirra/32760-03.html.text: Jinia: Why don't we talk to Kegor first? He must have much to say to you, adventurer.

Q10285_MeetingSirra/32760-04.html.text: Jinia: As I told you, the Ice Queen Freya used to be a princess named Felicia of the old Elmoreden Empire. Her natural beauty, her magical talent, and her lust for knowledge and power helped make her the perfect host for Freya. When Sayan's Ice Cystal broke, her body became its vessel. Her love for…

links.text: Ask if anything can be done.

Q10285_MeetingSirra/32760-07.html.text: Jinia: This is Sirra, formerly known as the Ice Fairy. Listen to her - she has some important things to say.

Q10285_MeetingSirra/32760-08.html.text: Jinia: I understand how all this must sound but Sirra is not lying.

Q10285_MeetingSirra/32760-15.html.text: Jinia: First, let's go to Freya's garden. I'll talk to the butler. We'll meet there.

Q10286_ReunionWithSirra/32760-01.html.text: Jinia: Thank the gods you survived. Are you all right?

Q10286_ReunionWithSirra/32760-05.html.text: Jinia: Sirra's appeared in the nick of time. Decide after you speak with Sirra. See things our way...

Q10286_ReunionWithSirra/32760-06.html.text: Jinia: I know she's not quite... right in the head, but it was right to keep the peace. To defeat Freya and save Felicia, we had to join forces with Sirra.

Q10287_StoryOfThoseLeft/32760-01.html.text: Jinia: Sirra's become Freya... We didn't see that coming.

Q10287_StoryOfThoseLeft/32760-04.html.text: Jinia: You look like you have something to say... Say it to Kier.

Q10287_StoryOfThoseLeft/32760-05.html.text: Jinia: You've done so much for us. I'd like to compensate you for your effort so far. Please accept the Guild's gratitude when you get out and meet Rafforty.

Q10283_RequestOfIceMerchant/32760-02.htm.text: Jinia: Well, who are you? Identify yourself or away with you.

Q10283_RequestOfIceMerchant/32760-03.htm.text: Jinia: Talk is cheap. Why am I to believe you? Give me a reason not to run you through right now for meddling with Kier.

links.text: "I'm telling the truth. Rafforty sent me to look for clues about the Divine Sword."

Q10283_RequestOfIceMerchant/32760-04.htm.text: Jinia: Ah, well, why didn't you say so to begin with? That information is known only to a select few amongst my Guild. I apologize for threatening you earlier, I have a lot on my mind just now. I will tell you though, you search Kier in vain. The Divine Sword is not here. You should go back to Raff…

Q10284_AcquisitionOfDivineSword/32760-02.text: Jinia: Before she became the dread Ice Queen, Freya had a different name. She was called Felicia and she was a princess of the old kingdom. She was a learned magician and pleasant enough, but she was expelled by her enemies within the court. A simple allegation of the study of dark magic was all it…

Jinia: At the time, I had other priorities. I sought to train in the kingdom's Knights of Kanna to become the strongest in the land. At some point, a Sage named Sayan came before the royal court. He said he found a crystal that held within in it immense power of cold, and was looking for someone wh…

Jinia: At the precise moment that Felicia and Sayan met, the crystal shattered and its energy washed over Felicia. Not long after, Sayan was nowhere to be found and Felicia soon began to change. She started insisting that others in the royal court call her Freya, and she became increasingly moody a…

Q10284_AcquisitionOfDivineSword/32760-03.text: Jinia: We were not always the Jinia Guild. We were once called the Knights of Kanna and it was our job to protect the royal family. When Felicia was expelled by her conspiring enemies within the court, we loyally followed her. When she became Freya, our mission quickly changed. We swore that we wou…

Jinia: The name Jinia is derived from a flower that used to bloom in this region. It was not rare, but beautiful nonetheless. When Freya began her reign as the Ice Queen, the Jinia flower stopped blooming because of the eternal winter. Always waiting for a spring that never comes. We named the guil…
Jinia: My name? Ah, it is an honor bestowed on each leader of the guild. I inherited the title from the previous leader, Kier, who led the Knights of Kanna in the days of old.

Q10284_AcquisitionOfDivineSword/32760-04.text: Jinia: The Divine Sword was a symbol of loyalty in the old kingdom of Elmoreden. The leader of the Knights of Kanna, Kier, wielded it when he guarded Felicia and the rest of the royal court.

Jinia: Yes… that was a tragedy. We thought Princess Felicia existed somewhere within the Ice Queen's mind. However, when Kier tried to convince her to give up her power and sway her from evil, she turned him to ice. I fear Felicia may be gone forever and now there is only Freya. Our mission to turn…

links.text: "So what are we going to do?"

Q10284_AcquisitionOfDivineSword/32760-04.text: Jinia: Currently, one of our knights, Kegor, possesses the Divine Sword. I'm afraid this means trouble.

Q10284_AcquisitionOfDivineSword/32760-05.text: Jinia: There is more to tell.
Jinia: There is more to tell.
Jinia: There is more to tell.
Jinia: All I have left to tell you is about the Ice Queen. After that, I will ask something very important of you.
Jinia: All I have left to tell you is about the Jinia Guild. After that, I will ask something very important of you.
Jinia: All I have left to tell you is about the Divine Sword. After that, I will ask something very important of you.
Jinia: I've told you all there is to say. Now it is time to discuss the mission.

Q10284_AcquisitionOfDivineSword/32760-06.text: Jinia: So, I mentioned Kegor earlier. Currently, he is the only person in Jinia Guild who can handle the sword. He was following a clue about its whereabouts to the Mithril Mines. Unfortunately, Freya found out and cornered him there.

Q10284_AcquisitionOfDivineSword/32760-07.text: Jinia: The problem is, he doesn't have an antidote to the poison she cast on him. You see, Kegor was Kier's pupil, and when he was turned to ice, Kegor lost his temper. Right before I found you at Kier's sculpture, Kegor heard the sword was at the mine and left in search of it. He traveled deep wit…

Q10285_MeetingSirra/32760-02.html.text: Jinia: The Guild exists to stop the Ice Queen Freya, but it's become clear that we aren't strong enough. Everyone we've sent against her has disappeared. Take a moment to talk with Kegor. He wanted to thank you again.

Q10285_MeetingSirra/32760-05.html.text: Jinia: I am not sure. As I told you before, I fear that Felicia may be lost forever, since she froze even her best friend Kier. But it's possible Felicia's soul still exists somewhere within the Ice Queen, weakening Freya. We have an idea - we might strengthen Felicia's spirit through some sort of …

Q10285_MeetingSirra/32760-06.html.text: Jinia: Who is this? What is this woman? Find out what she's doing here!

Q10285_MeetingSirra/32760-09.html.text: Jinia: Our guild has looked at every option. Nothing seems like it will work. It has been said that 'the enemy of the enemy is one's friend.' Sirra is certainly Freya's enemy, egomaniacal wizard though she may be. Her power would be of great help to us.

Q10285_MeetingSirra/32760-10.html.text: Jinia: I know, Sirra's not quite like us. Her aims are not the same. She's been our enemy before and I don't doubt that she might be again. But right now, Freya is the greater evil and we need Sirra's help. This is our best chance at stopping the Ice Queen.

Q10285_MeetingSirra/32760-11.html.text: Jinia: We need your help. With your strength, this plan could work! The Ice Queen must be stopped... Please, I'll do anything.

Q10285_MeetingSirra/32760-12.html.text: Jinia: (Beams, her smile wide) Thank you so much. Freya's threat won't end here. Like I said, we have to stop her before she tries to conquer the world with her icy grip. Let us meet at the Queen's Garden. I'll talk to the butler and let him know you're coming. See you there.

Q10285_MeetingSirra/32760-13.html.text: Jinia: Let our visitor out, please.

Q10286_ReunionWithSirra/32760-02.html.text: Jinia: I am sure we approached Freya the wrong way. Like I said before... we probably aren't strong enough to confront her directly. She's just too powerful.

Q10286_ReunionWithSirra/32760-03.html.text: Jinia: Victory is ours only when we have separated Freya's spirit from Felicia's body. We'll need a medium that can absorb Freya's essence instantly.

Q10286_ReunionWithSirra/32760-04.html.text: Jinia: I truly believe we have to give Freya's chamberlain, Sirra, a real chance. If it wasn't for her, I wouldn't know such a medium even existed, and it's the one thing that could make this plan work.

Q10286_ReunionWithSirra/32760-07.html.text: Jinia: When you are finished preparing, we will engage in a battle that will determine the fate of the world. Meet at the Ice Queen's castle garden again. This time we'll be ready.

Q10287_StoryOfThoseLeft/32760-02.html.text: Jinia: I have the frozen core, the one Sirra used to have.

Q10287_StoryOfThoseLeft/32760-03.html.text: Jinia: I've waited a long time to fight for this land! Jinia Guild's objective is more clear now. Adventurer, I see words behind your closed lips... Why don't you have a talk with Kegor.
